input.answer: Ontario's CPI rent index rose 2.0% between September 2025 and September 2026. The index went from 161.2 to 164.4. Calculation: (164.4 − 161.2) / 161.2 = 3.2 / 161.2 = 1.985%, which rounds to 2.0%. I read "rent" as the CPI "Rent" component for Ontario, not asking rents.
